package main

import (
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func Names(items []string) []string {
	var out []string
	for i := 0; i < len(items); i++ {
		out = append(out, strings.ToUpper(items[i]))
	}
	return out
}

func Has(items []string, want string) bool {
	for _, it := range items {
		if it == want {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(Names([]string{"a"}), Has(nil, "x"))
}
